name: Mass Game
source:
During this short game your hero will travel to "Omega" space station on the outskirts of the Terminus Systems and attempt to have some good time with sexy girls and alien girls in the "Afterlife" nightclub.

[From Patreon]
translation:
在这个短游戏中，你的英雄将前往终点站系统郊区的“欧米茄”空间站，并尝试在“来世”夜总会与性感女孩和外星女孩共度美好时光。

[来自帕特伦]
